parameters.help_en: The product entry region, which is determined by the selected region endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 产品入口地域，由所选地域端点确定
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The current routed workspace. The server verifies the account, region, and resource ownership. This parameter cannot be omitted or used to access other workspaces
parameters.help_zh: 当前路由的 Workspace，服务端校验账号、地域及资源归属；不允许省略或访问其他 Workspace
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: Performs a case-insensitive literal substring search on the complete source image reference in the registry/repository:tag format, where the repository already includes the namespace. If the value is empty after trimming leading and trailing whitespace, it is treated as not provided. Percent signs, underscores, and backslashes are treated as literal characters
parameters.help_zh: 对 registry/repository:tag 完整源镜像引用做不区分大小写的字面子串搜索，repository 已含 namespace；首尾空白去除后为空按未提供处理，百分号、下划线及反斜线均为普通字符
parameters.name: image_ref_contains

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source ACR Enterprise instance. The match must be exact. Empty character strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 源 ACR 企业版实例 ID，精确相等；空字符串非法
parameters.name: acr_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the source repository. The match is case-insensitive and must be exact. Do not include the protocol, path, or tag. Public network and VPC domain names are not considered equal. Empty strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 源仓库域名，精确相等且不区分大小写；不含协议、路径或 Tag，公网与 VPC 域名不视为相等；空字符串非法
parameters.name: registry

parameters.help_en: The source namespace. The match is case-sensitive and must be exact. Empty strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 源命名空间，区分大小写、精确相等；空字符串非法
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the repository under the namespace. The match is case-sensitive and must be exact. Do not include the namespace. If this parameter is provided, the namespace parameter must also be provided. Empty strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间下的仓库名，区分大小写、精确相等；不含 namespace，传入时必须同时提供 namespace；空字符串非法
parameters.name: repository

parameters.help_en: The tag of the source image. The match is case-sensitive and must be exact. The latest tag is not inferred. Empty strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 源镜像标签，区分大小写、精确相等，不推断 latest；空字符串非法
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The complete image digest in the sha256: format followed by a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string. The format is verified by the console. The match must be exact, and prefixes are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 完整 sha256: 加 64 位小写十六进制摘要，由 Console 校验格式，精确相等，不支持前缀
parameters.name: digest

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by a single cache status. Omit this parameter to query all statuses
parameters.help_zh: 按单一缓存状态筛选；查询全部时省略
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Omit this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, pass the nextToken value from the previous response exactly as returned. If the filter conditions change, you must query the first page again
parameters.help_zh: 首次省略，后续原样回传上一响应的 nextToken；改变筛选条件应重新查询首批
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. If this parameter is not provided or is set to 0, the default value is 20. If the value exceeds 100, it is treated as 100. Negative values return an InvalidMaxResults error. The value can be adjusted for subsequent pages
parameters.help_zh: 未传或为 0 默认 20；超过 100 按 100 执行；负数报 InvalidMaxResults；后续页允许调整
parameters.name: max_results

items.description_en: The records on the current page. An empty array is returned if no matching items are found
items.description_zh: 当前页记录，无匹配项时为空数组

items.description_en: List and Get operations return the current status, while Create and Retry operations return the snapshot of the same acceptance. All fields are required, and nullable fields must explicitly return null
items.description_zh: List/Get 返回当前状态，Create/Retry 返回同次受理快照。所有字段必返，可空字段必须显式返回 null

acrInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the source ACR Enterprise instance
acrInstanceId.description_zh: 源 ACR 企业版实例 ID

agentCount.description_en: The deduplicated number of agents in the current workspace that have useImageCache set to true and are associated with this logical resource. The value is greater than or equal to 0. This matches the set filtered by imageCacheId in ListAllAgents. Disabled agents are not counted, and this value is independent of the number of occupied instances
agentCount.description_zh: 当前 Workspace 内 useImageCache=true 且关联本逻辑资源的 Agent 去重数，大于等于 0；与 ListAllAgents 的 imageCacheId 筛选同集合。关闭即不计入，与实例占用数量无关
agentCount.title_en: 使用缓存的 Agent 数量
agentCount.title_zh: 使用缓存的 Agent 数量

cacheSizeBytes.description_en: The actual cache size in bytes. The value is greater than or equal to 0 if known, or null if unknown. The compressed size of the source image cannot be used as a substitute
cacheSizeBytes.description_zh: 实际缓存容量，已知值大于等于 0；未知为 null，不能用源镜像压缩大小代填

canDelete.description_en: Indicates whether the resource can be deleted. The value is true if no configuration references with the switch enabled exist in the current workspace, no valid instances are occupying the resource, and the resource is not being deleted. If the reference status is unknown, the query fails instead of defaulting to true
canDelete.description_zh: 当前 Workspace 无开启开关的配置引用且无有效实例占用、资源不在删除中时为 true。引用状态未知应使查询失败，不能默认允许

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the logical resource in the current workspace, in RFC 3339 format with the time zone. Content updates for the latest tag do not refresh this time
createdAt.description_zh: 当前 Workspace 逻辑资源创建时间，含时区 RFC3339 格式；latest 内容更新不刷新

deleteBlockReason.description_en: The reason why deletion is blocked. The value is null if canDelete is true. Otherwise, the value is returned based on the priority of DELETING, AGENT_ENABLED, and INSTANCES_RELEASING. Old instances may still occupy the resource even if the agent count is 0
deleteBlockReason.description_zh: canDelete=true 时为 null；否则按 DELETING、AGENT_ENABLED、INSTANCES_RELEASING 的优先级返回。Agent 数量为 0 仍可能有旧实例占用

digest.description_en: The digest in the sha256: format followed by a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string. It only describes the currently registered content and does not indicate whether old instances have been switched
digest.description_zh: sha256: 加 64 位小写十六进制；只描述当前登记内容，不证明旧实例已切换

error.description_en: The cache failure details. It is a non-null object when the status is FAILED, and null for other statuses. It only describes the current content and the current creation attempt
error.description_zh: FAILED 时必为非空对象，其他状态为 null；只描述当前内容和当前制作轮次

code.description_en: The secure and non-empty error code for the current creation attempt
code.description_zh: 安全且非空的当前制作错误码

message.description_en: The secure and non-empty description of the failure. It does not contain credentials, internal addresses, or stack traces
message.description_zh: 安全且非空的展示原因，不含凭证、内部地址或堆栈
message.example: 镜像缓存制作失败，请重试。

imageId.description_en: The logical resource ID that can be managed in the current workspace. This is not the shared physical cache ID
imageId.description_zh: 当前 Workspace 可管理的逻辑资源 ID，不是共享物理缓存 ID

registry.description_en: The domain name of the source image. It does not include the protocol, path, or credentials

repository.description_en: The path of the source image repository in the namespace/repository format. The namespace is included

status.description_en: The status of the image cache. Valid values: PENDING (creating), READY (available), FAILED (abnormal), and DELETING (deleting in the current workspace)
status.description_zh: PENDING 创建中，READY 可用，FAILED 异常，DELETING 当前 Workspace 删除中

tag.description_en: The tag of the source image. It is case-sensitive. Regular tags cannot be registered with different digests, except for the exact lowercase 'latest'
tag.description_zh: 保留大小写；普通 tag 不允许登记为不同 Digest，仅精确小写 latest 例外

workspaceId.description_en: The workspace ID. It must be consistent with the requested workspace. Resources with the same content from other workspaces must not be returned
workspaceId.description_zh: 与请求 Workspace 一致，禁止返回其他 Workspace 的同内容资源

items.title_en: 工作空间镜像缓存详情
items.title_zh: 工作空间镜像缓存详情

items.title_en: 当前页记录，无匹配项时为空数组。
items.title_zh: 当前页记录，无匹配项时为空数组。

maxResults.description_en: The actual page size used for this request. This is not the number of items on the current page
maxResults.description_zh: 本次实际采用的页长，不是本页条数
maxResults.title_en: 本次实际采用的页长，不是本页条数。
maxResults.title_zh: 本次实际采用的页长，不是本页条数。

nextToken.description_en: The opaque cursor for the next page. An empty string indicates that no more pages are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页不透明游标，空字符串表示结束
nextToken.title_en: 下一页不透明游标，空字符串表示结束。
nextToken.title_zh: 下一页不透明游标，空字符串表示结束。

requestId.description_en: The request ID used for troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查问题
requestId.title_en: 请求 ID，用于排查问题。
requestId.title_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查问题。

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of true does not indicate that the cache creation is complete
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，不代表缓存制作完成
success.title_en: 请求是否成功，不代表缓存制作完成。
success.title_zh: 请求是否成功，不代表缓存制作完成。

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current filter conditions. Do not use this value to determine whether all pages have been returned
totalCount.description_zh: 当前过滤条件下的记录总数，不用于判断遍历结束
totalCount.title_en: 当前过滤条件下的记录总数，不用于判断遍历结束。
totalCount.title_zh: 当前过滤条件下的记录总数，不用于判断遍历结束。

schema.title_en: 查询镜像缓存列表响应
schema.title_zh: 查询镜像缓存列表响应
